title: Unify Gallery catalog and availability
scope: Replace platform-specific scene arrays and index remapping with one catalog that combines shared metadata with queried backend capabilities.
acceptance: Desktop, Android and iPad consume the same ordered scene identities, names, descriptions and required feature records.
Unsupported scenes remain visible with a precise reason and cannot silently fall back to another backend.
evidence: PASS: cmake --build build-macos-metal-preview --target parallel-mater-gallery parallel-mater-gallery-session-contract-tests parallel-mater-ipad-session-tests parallel-mater-gallery-registry-tests parallel-mater-gallery-input-tests -j6; ctest matching those four contract suites; Metal; 4/4 passed.

PASS: JAVA_HOME=/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@17/libexec/openjdk.jdk/Contents/Home ANDROID_HOME=/Users/thomasbutyn/Android/Sdk ./scripts/Build-AndroidGallery.sh; SDK 36, CMake 4.1.2, NDK 29 ARM64 Vulkan debug APK; BUILD SUCCESSFUL.

PASS: physical iPad13,8 Apple M1 GPU Metal preview; shared catalog reported 28/28 scenes available and 28/28 three-frame render/control smoke passes; OS background/foreground recovery preserved frame count.
